About Beijing Guoan

Beijing Guoan live scores, players, season schedule and today’s results are available on Sofascore.

Beijing Guoan next match

Beijing Guoan will play the next match against Qingdao Hainiu on Oct 9, 2026, 11:35:00 AM UTC in Chinese Super League.

When the match starts, you will be able to follow Qingdao Hainiu vs Beijing Guoan live score, standings, minute by minute updated live results and match statistics.

We may have video highlights with goals and news for some Beijing Guoan matches, but only if they play their match in one of the most popular football leagues.

Beijing Guoan previous match

Beijing Guoan previous match was against Pohang Steelers in AFC Champions League Elite, the match ended with result 3 - 1 (Beijing Guoan won the match).

Beijing Guoan fixtures tab is showing the last 100 football matches with statistics and win/draw/lose icons.

There are also all Beijing Guoan scheduled matches that they are going to play in the future.

Beijing Guoan performance and form graph is a Sofascore unique algorithm that we are generating from the team's last 10 matches, statistics, detailed analysis and our own knowledge.

This graph may help predict future Beijing Guoan matches.

About
Football live scores on Sofascore livescore has live coverage from more than 500 worldwide soccer leagues, cups and tournaments with live updated results, statistics, league tables, video highlights, and fixtures. Live matches from all football leagues have fast and accurate updates for minutes, scores, halftime and full time soccer results, goal scorers and assistants, cards, substitutions, and match statistics.
